rich_text_fields.html: Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW), Shri Sarbananda Sonowal, visited The Energy and Resources Institute’s (TERI) Gwal Pahari campus in Gurugram and reviewed a series of green shipping initiatives, positioning the sector's decarbonisation as a priority area for his ministry.
